The '''GPE-3300''' was a high performance [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] designed by [[Galactic Power Engineering/Legends|Galactic Power Engineering]]. It was an unorthodox design that had two large engines and an underslung cockpit. This made it hard to land on solid ground and it usually had to dock at floating platforms.<ref name="LECG" />

[[File:Lecg-gpe3300.jpg|thumb|left|GPE-3300 airspeeder]]
It was fast and maneuverable, and many were owned by [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] as a status symbol. They were also often used by planetary police forces as pursuit craft.<ref name="LECG" />
